relations: Calm water mirrors the shoreline trees, so any surface ripple would distort those reflections.
The canoe floats beside the dock in shallow water, so wind or contact could drift it away.
The wooden dock is anchored to the rocky shore, giving a fixed reference for nearby floating objects.
Bags rest on the bank between dock and canoe, so disturbance could shift them relative to both.
